environment.timeout_preflight_warning: options.timeout_s (60s) looks implausible for a tran analysis with ~6.1e+03 timepoints (10e-12 step, 61e-9 window) -- even 50 timepoints/s (a generous floor, not a real engine-rate estimate) would need 122s per corner. This is only a coarse, advisory pre-grid heuristic -- it does not block the sweep, and a plausible-looking budget can still turn out to be too short in practice.
